Name: Let them eat cake
Proposed text: Deal 3 damage to target unit. If it is a Gourmand unit, destroy it instead and create a Garbage.
Proposed flavour: The Gourmands always said it was to die for.
Reason: A dead card outside the Endless Buffet: in PvE most foes are not Gourmand, so the only opposing-Path hate card in the set sits in hand. Straight "destroy" is the Necrocrat removal rule; Refusemancer removes with damage and brawls. The upgrade keeps the Gourmand grudge as a bonus. Name to title case ("Let Them Eat Cake"); cost written without the space.
Evidence: Design Guidance REMOVAL (Refusemancer: damage, brawl, traps; Necrocrat: straight destroy); PATH IDENTITY (opposes Gourmands). Only 1 of the 4 opposing-Path pairs has a hate card.

Name: Landfill Ox
Current text: Exhaust, eat garbage twice, lose 1 HP: add (R)(R)(R)(R).
Proposed text: Exhaust, eat garbage: add (R)(R)(R).
Proposed flavour: Not a beast of burden. A beast of garbage.
Reason: A three-part cost (exhaust, two eats, HP) on a Common; after paying 2 energy for the two eats the net gain is +2 energy for 1 HP and two Garbage. One eat for +2 net energy is the same ramp with one clear cost and no HP line, which the guidance reserves for stronger cards.
Evidence: Design Guidance RARITY Common ("one clear effect"); PATH MECHANICS Eat Garbage ("Specific stronger cards add a written lose X HP cost").

Name: The Recycling Center
Current text: At the end of your turn, you may use two Garbage. If you do, return target card from your Refuse Pile to your hand.
Proposed text: Use two Garbage: return target card from your Refuse Pile to your hand. Do this only once per turn.
Proposed flavour: Nothing is wasted. Not even you.
Reason: End-of-turn timing returns the card when it can no longer be played that turn, so the Wonder never feels like it does anything. The repeatable-Wonder template (your turn, once per turn) makes the recursion immediate.
Evidence: docs/design/starting_decks.md: "The Recycling Center was the deck's least helpful card in the simulation (0% when played)" and was cut from the starter. TEXT TEMPLATES (repeatable Wonder abilities).

Name: Reclaimed Land
Current text: When an Infrastructure enters under your opponent's control, if they control more Infrastructure than you, search your deck for two Infrastructure and put them onto the field.
Proposed text: When an Infrastructure enters under your opponent's control, search your deck for an Infrastructure and put it onto the field.
Proposed flavour: Possession is nine-tenths of the landfill.
Reason: A count comparison plus a two-card search is Uncommon complexity; the one-card version still ramps the Path and reads in one breath. Keep the long version if the card moves to Uncommon.
Evidence: Design Guidance RARITY (Common 1-2 lines, Uncommon synergy/complexity).

Name: Rusty Can Opener
Current text: Destroy this Tool: destroy target Tool, Wonder, or resource.
Proposed text: Destroy this Tool: destroy target Tool, Wonder or resource. Create a Garbage.
Proposed flavour: Opens anything. Eventually.
Reason: In PvE many foes never show a Tool or Wonder and the resource target is a small payoff, so the Tool rots in hand; a Garbage keeps it on-theme and never dead.
Evidence: Balance sim review_one_refusemancer.md: lift -35 when played (5 games, noisy) vs the Mossy Trash Golem; CUT_ORDER cuts it early.

Name: The Cullinator

Name: Push Broom of Undeath
Current text: Whenever a unit attacks, you may Shred any number of Garbage, Iron, and Ingredients.
Proposed text: Exhaust: attach to target unit you control. Attached unit gets +0/+1. Whenever attached unit attacks, destroy up to two target resources your opponent controls.
Proposed flavour: Sweeps up the Iron, the scraps and the Ingredients. Files them under "trash".
Reason: A Common Tool that follows neither Tool template (not attached, not one-shot), triggers on ANY player's attack, and Shreds resources (Shred is the rare exile answer; resources are destroyed or used). The flavour is a long in-joke about the train. The attached version is a Red-Tape-free resource-denial Tool, the Path's weakness-of-choice vs Gourmand and Refusemancer engines. Trim the trailing spaces in the name and cost cells.
Evidence: Design Guidance CARD TYPES Tool; TEXT TEMPLATES Tool attach; CORE TERMS Shred ("use sparingly"); RARITY Common.

Name: Hamster Ball

Name: Shredded Spectre
Current text: Use 3 Red Tape: this unit gains Elusive until end of turn. Use 3 Iron: this unit gets +1 attack until end of turn.
Proposed text: Whenever you use a Red Tape or an Iron, this unit gets +1/+0 and gains Elusive until end of turn.
Proposed flavour: Counting calories is so easy when you're dead. Being dead rules!
Reason: Using three Iron the normal way gives +3/+3; paying three for +1 attack is a trap for new players. Two separate three-resource costs on an Uncommon is also heavy. The trigger version rewards the pair's resources as they are used anyway and shortens the flavour.
Evidence: Design Guidance RESOURCES Iron (+1/+1 per use); RARITY Uncommon.

Name: Jello Weights
Current text: Exhaust, pay 1: attach to target unit you control. If it's a Necrocrat, it gets +5/+5. If it's a Beefcake, all Beefcakes you control get +1/+2.

Reason: IP: "Jell-O" is a trademark (name: "Wobble Weights" or "Gelatin Weights") and the flavour is a direct song lyric. Clarity: "if it's a Necrocrat" reads as the player; the rewrite names the unit.
Evidence: Design Guidance HUMOR + IP ("parody names and nods, not real brands... or direct quotes").
